Similarly, Testosterone also causes Gingival Swelling, which is associated with Miconazole, another compound that binds to Cyp2c9. These findings collectively indicate that Testosterone may influence Cyp2c9 through the binding of various drugs, suggesting a broader mechanism of action involving drug metabolism. The presence of multiple drug-target relationships, including Acenocoumarol and Miconazole, underscores the importance of Cyp2c9 in the metabolic processing of these compounds, and the involvement of Testosterone in initiating these pathways. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Testosterone exerts a regulatory effect on Cyp2c9 through the activation of drug-target interactions.
